# Whalesong Studio
**Write a long novel with a crew of AI agents — a plugin for DeepSeek Harness.**
**Whalesong Studio** (鲸歌工坊) is for writing long fiction with AI. You talk to a showrunner; behind it
, a small crew writes, keeps track of the story, reviews, draws and gives it a voice. Hundreds of th
ousands of words in, your characters are still themselves and the story still adds up. When the book
is done, you can publish it as an illustrated website in one click.
It isn't a role-play front end or a "generate a chapter" button: you make the calls, and each model
does the part it is good at.
*Lewis Carroll's* Alice's Adventures in Wonderland *imported into the Studio, open beside a conversa
tion with the showrunner. Every picture in these screenshots was drawn in the Studio.*
**See what it makes:** two classics published with Whalesong Studio — read *Alice's Adventures in Wo
nderland* or *Dream of the Red Chamber* (红楼梦, in Chinese) online. The first chapters can be listened
to as well — the first three of *Alice*, the first ten of 红楼梦 — voiced by the Studio. Once inside,
click **People** and **World** at the top: every character has a page of their own, the main ones wi
th portraits, and the places can be walked into one inside another.
> **New here?** The tutorial walks you through it with screenshots, from installing to your first il
e tutorial walks you through it with screenshots, from installing to your first illustrated chapter.
## A crew, not a single model
Models that plan well and use tools well rarely write beautiful prose, and the best prose writers ra
rely manage a big project well. So Whalesong Studio doesn't ask one model to do everything:
| Role | What it does |
| **Showrunner** (总编) | The one you talk to, on any model you like. Works out what you want, plans w

hat comes next, hands out the work and reports back. It never writes the story itself. |
| **Writer*
* (写手) | Writes the prose, on a model you choose. Before every chapter it is handed everything that
chapter needs: the setting, where each character stands, what came before, the open threads, the out

line and the style. |
| **Continuity** (场记) | Remembers. After every chapter it notes what happened
and how everyone has changed. It also reviews like an editor — and when it says something contradict

s an earlier chapter, it shows you the passage. |
| **Planner** (策划) | Has the ideas. Works out what
could happen next, fleshes out the characters and the world, tries "what if…" turns of the story, a

nd can look things up on the web. |
| **Director** (导演) | Sound and pictures. Adapts chapters into a
udio drama and storyboards, and plays everyone else when you step into a scene as one of the charact

ers. |
| **Post-production** (后期) | Edits voices, sound and pictures into a video, checks the result
itself, and hands it over only when it passes. |
The four crew members are real agents running on DeepSeek Harness's own agent loop, and every job th
ey do leaves a full record in your conversation: what they looked up, what they handed in, what it c
ost. Prefer buttons to chat? Everything can be done from the Studio's own screens, too.
## Highlights
### Hundreds of thousands of words in, nothing is forgotten
After every chapter the Studio notes what happened, where each character stands and which threads mo
ved. When the next chapter is written, the writer gets a summary of everything before plus the last
few chapters in full — the whole book, while it's short enough — along with any earlier passages tha
t matter. A style profile keeps the voice steady. Ask for what comes next, a fix to a paragraph, a r
ewrite of a chapter or one change carried through the whole book: every change is shown to you first
, side by side, and the previous version is always kept.
### Every character gets a page, every place can be explored
Each character has a card — personality, relationships, what they go through in the book, how they l
ook and sound — and every later picture and spoken line follows it. Places nest inside one another:
Wonderland holds the hall of doors, the wood, the garden and the March Hare's house. Beside the text
, **People** shows each character's page with a large portrait, and **World** opens any place to sho
w its picture, what it contains and who lives there.
| *People — who they are, how they look, what they go through* | *World — what is in a place, and wh
they are, how they look, what they go through* | *World — what is in a place, and who lives there* |
### Read it, hear it, watch it
A reader with careful typography and the book's own pictures in the text; one switch turns it into a
n audiobook, with every character keeping one voice through the whole book. Pictures stay consistent
too: each character first gets a design sheet — front, side and back — and every later picture is d
rawn to match. Go further with an **audio drama**, a **motion comic** that plays along with the voic
es, a chapter cut into a **video**, or an **interlude** — play one of the characters in a scene whil
e the others answer you.
| *Read — and with one switch, listen* | *Gallery — one look per book; every picture remembers how i
with one switch, listen* | *Gallery — one look per book; every picture remembers how it was made* |
The pictures can come from any image model you like — GPT Image, Qwen-Image, FLUX, Seedream… or a mo
del running on your own computer.
### Publish it as a work of digital art
When the book is ready, publish it as a website in one click: the text set for reading, a portrait a
nd a short biography for every character, and places your readers can step into. Nothing to install,
and it reads well on a phone. The two classics linked above were made exactly this way.
## What is sent where
- Text goes to the models you chose for the roles: a role that follows the conversation model or use
s a Harness model goes through the Harness LLM runtime (the same routes, credentials and retry polic

y as your conversations); a role with an endpoint of its own is called by the Studio directly.
- Ima
ge prompts, the text of lines to be spoken and (if enabled) text chunks to be embedded go to the med
ia endpoints you configured. Nothing is sent to any endpoint you did not configure; there is no tele

metry.
- Keys stay in the Harness credential store on your machine and are only ever sent to the end

point host they were entered for.
- Books stay in your workspace. Settings live in `$DSH_HOME/novel-

t they were entered for.
- Books stay in your workspace. Settings live in `$DSH_HOME/novel-writer/`.
